Metadata.Goal: Replace the legacy first reference context with a neutral Live Event Operations domain while preserving the complete executable feature matrix.
Metadata.Description: Adopt event-operations-lifecycle as the first production reference bundle, migrate its model, operations, presets, handlers, probes, server tests and browser tests, and remove legacy-domain traces from current product truth.

TaskSpace.name: adopt-live-event-operations-reference-domain
TaskSpace.Description: Freeze the EventOps matrix, replace the bundle implementation, migrate integration expectations, then prove parity and absence of current legacy-domain traces.

TaskGroup.name: Live Event Operations bundle
TaskGroup.Description: Replace the first bundle's complete model, catalog, presets, handlers, probes and package-level matrix tests without changing runtime contracts.

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: the exact 12-operation EventOps matrix and four-child CancelEvent tree execute through public runtime APIs
Commerce behavior and protected capsule state remain unchanged

Task.name: Implement Live Event Operations bundle and matrix
Task.Description: Rename the first reference bundle, model, semantic resources, seeds, definitions, presets, child refs, handlers and probes to the EventOps vocabulary. Rename package tests and assertions tests-first, preserving all owner/behavior/subject/invocation/effect, transaction, observation and failure semantics.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: event-operations-lifecycle exposes exactly 12 EventOps definitions with the frozen mapping in design.md
CancelEvent invokes QueryAssociatedEvent, ValidateAttendeesNotified, MarkCanceled and ReleaseEventSlot in order, commits on success and rolls back on failure
association, lifecycle, constraint, business-process and extension Action presets produce truthful relational observations
domain-context-bundles tests/build pass and Commerce expectations are unchanged

TaskGroup.name: Server and Workbench migration
TaskGroup.Description: Migrate public catalog and browser acceptance to the new domain identity without weakening exact request or observation assertions.

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: server integration and Workbench E2E execute the new reference bundle
current production and test truth contains no retired reference-domain identifiers

Task.name: Migrate server and browser acceptance
Task.Description: Update server reference-context tests and Domain Workbench E2E to select event-operations-lifecycle, assert EventOps request/operation/model facts, execute success/failure/diagnostic flows, and keep Commerce plus Kon IDE coverage intact.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: production catalog exposes event-operations-lifecycle and commerce-operations, with no legacy first-bundle id
Workbench preview and POST assertions use EventOps.CancellationCase.CancelEvent and its exact request facts
failure diagnostics and visible child operation prefix remain covered in browser tests
server tests and complete Chromium E2E pass without weakening existing assertions

TaskGroup.name: Parity and residue verification
TaskGroup.Description: Prove full feature parity, public-boundary integrity and removal of the retired example from current non-archived truth.

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: focused package tests, root build and 21-case Chromium E2E pass
live source, tests and promoted behaviors contain only EventOps and Commerce reference identities

Task.name: Verify matrix parity and clean current truth
Task.Description: Run contract/runtime/bundle/server/IDE suites, root build, complete E2E, import guards, current-truth residue scans, XML/diff checks and capsule fingerprints. Update only track reports/status; do not rewrite historical archives.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: all focused mission-owned package tests and root build pass
Chromium E2E passes 21/21 with the new reference domain
non-archived product source/tests and promoted behavior target state have no retired domain identity or vocabulary
packages/depa-orm-capsule remains byte-for-byte unchanged and outside test scope
